verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a GitHub sync exists (e.g., 'Open a GitHub-synced issue in GitHub' and GitHub team/review assignment features) implying issues can link and stay in sync with GitHub, but there is no detailed documentation of full bi-directional status/field syncing or duplication avoidance mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit description of two-way status sync (e.g., closing PR auto-closing issue), field mapping, and independent confirmation of no data duplication.
